Use case: ui-mockup. Production UI sprite source for the supplied hand-painted Daoist chibi mahjong game. Images 1 and 2 are mandatory style references; Image 3 is the current lobby. Match jade green, warm ivory silk, restrained warm gold edging, soft rounded cloud/rǔyì corners and fine hand-painted shading. Crisp readable shapes; avoid plastic gloss, noisy textures, photorealism. NO text, NO letters, NO numbers, NO watermarks, NO characters, NO scenery. Empty control faces are intentional: all labels will be native client text. Real transparent RGBA background; never draw checkerboards or matte backdrops. Each sprite must have a clean alpha outline and be fully isolated with generous spacing.
Create ONE large landscape hollow rectangular game window frame on a 16:9 canvas, requested 2048x1152. Front-on orthographic view, perfectly level. The external frame fills about 88% canvas width and 78% height, with 6%+ transparent margin. Warm ivory carved border, jade-green thin inner trim, refined gold edging and rounded cloud details confined to the four corners. Straight edges and quiet central stretches suitable for nine-slice scaling. The entire large rectangular CENTER HOLE must be genuinely transparent, with no ivory panel fill, no glass and no artwork. The outside is also transparent. Do not include a title plaque or any button. Deliver only the continuous hollow border.
